result.reason: The Licensor indemnity substantially reaches the preferred position and appropriately overrides Article XIII, but the Licensee indemnity is not limited to Licensee-provided content and breach of law. It still includes the broad opening allocation of sole responsibility and subsection (i), covering liabilities arising from any exercise of licensed rights. The margin comment inaccurately states that the Licensee indemnity was fully narrowed. The edits are otherwise targeted and preserve unrelated terms, though the new provision has minor drafting issues, including “any third-party claim” followed by “all resulting” losses and a narrower data-breach formulation limited to unauthorized access or disclosure.
